record.original_question: Fix a color-critical graph F with chromatic number chi(F) = r + 1 >= 4. For all sufficiently large m, what is the extremal graph with maximal spectral radius among all non-r-partite F-free graphs with m edges?

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Let F be a color-critical graph with chi(F) = r + 1 >= 4. For all sufficiently large m, what is the extremal graph with maximal spectral radius over all non-r-partite F-free graphs on m edges?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F$ be a color-critical graph with chromatic number $\chi(F)=r+1\ge 4$, where a graph $F$ is called color-critical if there exists an edge $e\in E(F)$ such that $\chi(F-e)<\chi(F)$. A graph $G$ is $F$-free if it contains no subgraph isomorphic to $F$, and $G$ is non-$r$-partite if its vertex set cannot be partitioned into $r$ independent sets. The spectral radius $\rho(G)$ of a graph $G$ is the largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix.

Determine, for all sufficiently large $m$, the graph(s) that attain the maximum spectral radius over the family of all non-$r$-partite, $F$-free graphs with exactly $m$ edges.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem on spectral extremal graphs by edges, extending recent results that determine the extremal spectral radius among F-free graphs with m edges (without the non-r-partite constraint). Searches reveal related work on spectral extremal problems for color-critical graphs and graphs with given size, but no resolution of this specific non-r-partite variant for general color-critical F with chi(F) = r+1 >= 4.

status_evidence.title: Unsolved Problems in Spectral Graph Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems in spectral extremal graph theory, including spectral Turán-type problems for F-free graphs with given size.
status_evidence.claim: Spectral extremal problems for color-critical F-free graphs by number of edges remain an active area with several open cases.

status_evidence.title: The maximum spectral radius of {C3,C5}-free graphs of given size
status_evidence.snippet: Determines the maximum spectral radius of F-free graphs with m edges in particular cases.
status_evidence.claim: Recent works resolve specific F but not the general non-r-partite color-critical case.
